_about: The Bookshelf for Boys and Girls (New York: The University Society, 1912, in twenty volumes and an index; two volumes are 1915 printings): stories, nature, history, things to make and do, and literature for children. Ten of the twenty-one volumes are here, from 1912-1915 scans, as raw Internet Archive OCR; The later revised editions (1945-1958 printings) carry new copyrighted matter and are not taken. Added 2026-10-23 at Adam's ask for old children's sets.
